en: Dependent on a state that is with conflict (*saraṇa*) and leading to accumulation (*ācayagāmi*), a state that is without conflict (*na-saraṇa*) and not leading to accumulation arises by way of root condition (*hetu-paccaya*). ... Under root [condition], there are two; ... up to ... under non-disappearance [condition], there are two.

Dependent on a state that is without conflict and leading to diminution (*apacayagāmi*), a state that is without conflict and not leading to diminution arises by way of root condition. Under root [condition], there is one; ... up to ... under non-disappearance [condition], there is one.

Dependent on a state that is without conflict and neither leading to accumulation nor leading to diminution, a state that is without conflict and neither leading to accumulation nor leading to diminution arises by way of root condition. Under root [condition], there are two; ... up to ... under non-disappearance [condition], there are two.
